members.definition: orphan.hook-pre-tool is a workflow mechanism: a named pre-tool hook stage that runs before every tool invocation and may abort the call. Discriminating example: a deny from this hook prevents the tool from running, unlike a post-tool tracer which can only observe.
members.name: orphan.hook-pre-tool

stages.does: run the named hook before every tool invocation; abort the call on deny
invoke the tool only if the hook did not abort

vocabulary.definition: orphan.hook-pre-tool is a workflow mechanism: a named pre-tool hook stage that runs before every tool invocation and may abort the call. Discriminating example: a deny from this hook prevents the tool from running, unlike a post-tool tracer which can only observe.
discriminating_examples: a deny from this hook prevents the tool from running, unlike a post-tool tracer which can only observe
post-tool tracer cannot abort; this hook can

members.definition: orphan.not-worth.stub is a deprecated alias with no independent behaviour. It exists only so an older name still resolves; it must be preserved as an archive record so retirement does not silently delete the name, but it is not worth extracting into an active target blueprint for reuse.
members.name: orphan.not-worth.stub

stages.does: preserve the deprecated alias in the vocabulary so a RETIRE of its only candidate cannot delete the name; do not schedule this as a live stage

vocabulary.definition: orphan.not-worth.stub is a deprecated alias with no independent behaviour. It exists only so an older name still resolves; it must be preserved as an archive record so retirement does not silently delete the name, but it is not worth extracting into an active target blueprint for reuse.
discriminating_examples: alias with no extra stage behaviour vs a real hook or quorum

members.definition: orphan.reject-quorum is a workflow mechanism: a merge stage that cannot run until a named review quorum of independent reviewers has recorded PASS. Discriminating example: a single author self-ack does not satisfy the quorum; two distinct reviewer ids must vote, and the merge is refused while the vote set is short.
members.name: orphan.reject-quorum

stages.does: require two distinct reviewer PASS records; refuse author self-ack
run merge only after quorum PASS

vocabulary.definition: orphan.reject-quorum is a workflow mechanism: a merge stage that cannot run until a named review quorum of independent reviewers has recorded PASS. Discriminating example: a single author self-ack does not satisfy the quorum; two distinct reviewer ids must vote, and the merge is refused while the vote set is short.
discriminating_examples: a single author self-ack does not satisfy the quorum; two distinct reviewer ids must vote, and the merge is refused while the vote set is short
author self-ack is not a quorum
